name: Hano
subtitle: Hano SideStore Builds
description: Unsigned Hano builds for installation through SideStore.

apps.name: Hano
apps.subtitle: Modular AI chat and agent client
apps.localizedDescription: Hano is a modular iOS client for AI chat, local agents, device connectivity, and media workflows.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Hano 会使用蓝牙扫描、连接并调试附近的 BLE 设备。
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hano 需要使用相机拍照并发送到聊天。
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hano 会使用本地网络发现附近设备，用于局域网聊天与内容同步。
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hano 会使用一次城市级定位生成本地天气卡片，只输出城市和行政区，不会保存精确坐标。
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hano 需要使用麦克风进行语音录制和语音输入。
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hano 需要语音识别权限将语音实时转换为文字。
